_source.summary: Base attributes (no gear, no buffs) per class/race/level 1-60. See BASE_STATS.md.
_source.C: Existing Classic class/race pairs copied from player_levelstats in cmangos classic-db (ClassicDB_1_12_1_z2815, GPL-2.0), https://github.com/cmangos/classic-db
_source.F: Forever client RaceStat (build 1.60.1.70938) checked: its one unknown column is 0 for every race, so it holds no stats. Base attributes are server-side; no other client table was found to hold them.
_source.A_new_pairs: New Forever pairs built as Classic class curve (from the first Classic race of that class) minus that race's level-1 offset vs Human Warrior plus the target race's offset: warrior/sho, warrior/sws, paladin/undead, hunter/human, hunter/sho, hunter/sws, rogue/sho, rogue/sws, priest/gnome, shaman/dwarf, shaman/sws, mage/sho, mage/orc, warlock/troll, druid/sho, druid/sws
_source.A_skyborne: sho/sws: Night Elf offsets vs Human, but Str set to Human+5 (published Forever fix: Tauren Warrior +5 Str vs Human, same fix for both Skyborne). No published Skyborne table.
_source.A_tauren: Classic Tauren Warrior is already +5 Str vs Human at level 1, so the Tauren fix needs no change.
_source.A_fix: mage/undead level 1: cmangos has int 27 / spi 21, which looks swapped (Undead is Int -2, Spi +5 vs Human). Swapped to int 21 / spi 27.
